02 — Why time, not tokens

## Stop rationing your thinking.

Metered APIs bill every token, so every agent loop and every experiment becomes a cost decision. We sell capacity by time: the cost is agreed before you start, and your people and systems stop rationing their thinking.

- Predictable cost Agreed up front, per seat or per term.

- No token metering Use the capacity you bought.

- Terms that fit Seats, sessions, keys and terms are set per agreement.
